title: Cryostat — Snowflake Atelier
description: Grow real snow crystals on a hexagonal diffusion lattice — tune the weather, scrub the growth, export the specimen.
concept: Cryostat is a crystal-growth lab built on the Gravner–Griffeath snowflake model: a hexagonal cellular automaton where vapour diffuses, freezes onto the boundary, attaches, melts back and sublimates. Eight climate presets cover the real morphology zoo — fernlike dendrites, hex plates, sectored plates, capped columns, rimed stars, diamond dust — and every parameter is live, so shifting vapour density mid-growth caps a star the way a change of altitude does. The growth timeline is fully scrubbable because each cell remembers the step it froze on, and the specimen can be exported as a true-hexagon 2048px PNG, filed in a local vault, assembled into a labelled specimen sheet, or handed to someone else as a deterministic share link.
features: Gravner–Griffeath hexagonal diffusion automaton with 8 live physical parameters (ρ, β, α, θ, κ, μ, γ, σ)
8 climate presets spanning real snow-crystal morphology, plus Mutate and Random weather breeding
Scrubbable growth timeline — drag the canvas or the slider to replay freezing step by step
Three nucleus types and three lattice resolutions (201² / 301² / 401², 60fps)
Six palettes, three render styles, vapour-field and growth-ring overlays
Export a 2048px true-hexagon specimen PNG with a parameter caption
localStorage vault of up to 18 specimens with thumbnails, one-tap re-growth, and a labelled specimen-sheet export
Deterministic seeded noise so a share link reproduces the exact crystal

interaction.mouse: Drag horizontally across the crystal to scrub the growth timeline; wheel to zoom.
interaction.click: Double-click to pause or resume growth; presets, palettes and vault specimens are one click.
interaction.touch: Drag to scrub, pinch to zoom, double-tap to pause; the Lab sheet opens from the bottom-right.
interaction.keyboard: Space play/pause · R restart · ←/→ scrub · 1-8 presets · E export PNG · S save to vault · V vapour field · 0 reset zoom
